notes.title: Alternate Existence Season 1 release Q4 on Steam
notes.content:
Good day Everyone Misterknobb here

Thank you for playing and viewing Retrieving the Past Steam page. It's absolutely great to know you guys and gals took the time. Let me tell you about my next choice base, story driven Visual Novel !

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2017340/Alternate_Existence/]Alternate Existence[/url] will soon be available on Steam around Q4 or close to end of this year. You will be able to play Season 1 of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2017340/Alternate_Existence/]Alternate Existence[/url] which has a lot of content, incredibly gorgeous women, action, sci-fi and a kick ass story to boot.
Play as the main character who comes from rags to super confidant dude.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41446571/7f76767338bab946e652327719c8da73704249c4.jpg[/img]

[b]Synopsis[/b]:
I am 22 years old. I have no memory of my parents as a child and no idea who or where they might be. I lived with an older woman when I was younger but even that didn’t last. She passed me on to foster care and I bounced from one family to another like a pinball until an incident caused that dismal little game to crash, to an end. The day of the incident I left and never turned back.

I work a minimum wage grind at a grubby diner and when I manage to find the time, I study astronomy after hours. All this could quite possibly change with a snap of the fingers – the fingers belonging to this guy who walked in for a weak coffee and greasy fries. He came over and made an offer. He spoke and I listened. His speech wove one helluva tale. It presented a way out. A way that comes with a price.

So here I am, gnawing on his words in my head. Going over everything, he said, replaying it and hitting rewind, again and again. And I just can’t shake it. This deal of his. The idea that there is something just around the corner, something more to these nine to five drudges. His planted seed and the twisting words. The door cracking open to something else. Something more than just being, ‘me’. Still even with this 'deal' of his I can’t help but feel my life is not aligned. I can sense it, this alternative to my existence.

[b]NOTICE[/b]:
Take note ALL characters displayed in a sexual nature in the game are over 18 and the game is intended for 18 and older.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2017340/Alternate_Existence/]Alternate Existence[/url] is a harem game but will also have a girlfriend option. There are story driven women in game that you cannot choose to date or not. Then there are plenty of women that you can choose to start something with or not.

Another interesting thing to take note of is that some of the characters that appeared in Retrieving the Past will make an appearance in [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2017340/Alternate_Existence/]Alternate Existence[/url] as both games share the same universe.

[b]CHOICE BASED & STORY DRIVEN:[/b]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2017340/Alternate_Existence/]Alternate Existence[/url] will be more of a game than my previous Kinetic Novel, Retrieving the Past. In [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2017340/Alternate_Existence/]Alternate Existence[/url] you will have to make a choice to date, have fun with or just have sex with some of the women or, don't choose any of the women when given a choice.

Its heavily story driven with characters that will make you feel emotionally invested in them and letting them go may be something you may regret later on. If you choose not to hang out with a girl at all, there will still be plenty sexy time with the dedicated story driven girls in the game. You also get the chance at the start of the game to choose a "girlfriend" from two choices.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41446571/e3f123405d1d26c883a61f04cd70ea6ac101c809.jpg[/img]

So what do you as the player get for Season 1 of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2017340/Alternate_Existence/]Alternate Existence[/url]?

1. Total of 6597 images
2. Total of 339 animations
3. Total of 28256 lines dialogue and code
4. Audio - 90 sound files (All songs are written and recorded by MrKnobb)

Meaning hours and hours of story, game play and some sexy time with hot, beautiful women already for you to enjoy!

So don't be shy, add it to your wishlist NOW...

.: MrKnobb :.
